name: Daniel
overview: The biblical figure Daniel is portrayed as a devout and wise Jewish captive in Babylon, also known as Belteshazzar, who distinguished himself through his refusal to defile himself with the king's food and wine, demonstrating steadfast faith and purity of heart. Educated at the king's court, Daniel's wisdom was renowned, with even Ezekiel acknowledging his unparalleled insight and righteousness alongside Noah and Job. His life exemplifies courage and fidelity, as he faced conspiracy and was cast into the lions' den, yet remained faithful to God. Additionally, the name Daniel appears in other contexts, including as a descendant of Ithamar and a son of David, underscoring the name's significance across different biblical narratives.
